 17. Mr. Anisul Houqe, the learned Advocate for the appellant submits that motor cycle seized by GD entry no. 182 dated 07.11.1993 at Dhamoirhat police station was stolen motor cycle of Akkelpur police station case no. 2(6) 1991; that the accused appellants are quite innocent and that they have been falsely implicated in the case. It is further stated that the learned Divisional Special Judge, Rajshahi, by his order no. 17 dated 13.10.2004 directed Md. Monirul Hoque, District Anti corruption Officer, Rajshahi, to investigate the matter again. Accordingly he investigated the matter and submitted the supplementary charge sheet no. 10(1) dated 13.10.2004 before the learned Divisional Special Judge, Rajshahi, wherein he stated that stolen motorcycle was sent to the Motor vehicles Inspector, BRTA Bogra circle, Naogaon region, Joypurhat for inspection and report and the Inspector after inspection submitted report stating that the registration number of the motor cycle is. Naogaon A-661 whose owner is Abu Zafer Siddiky @ Akhter. The investigating officer Monirul Hoque also personally investigated chassis number and engine number of the motor cycle through magnifying glass came to the finding that though some interpolation was made on the numbers yet he ascertained that the seized Motorcycle was stolen motor cycle of Akkelpur police station case No. 2(6) 1991. The learned Advocate for the appellant further submits that SI Abdul Baten lawfully handed over the motor cycle to Abu Zafor Siddiky @ Akhter and that the learned Magistrate also passed an order dated 09.04.1995 for giving the motorcycle to the actual original owner and accordingly the seized motor cycle was delivered to the accused Abu Zafer Siddiky on 18.04.1995. It is further stated that accused appellant Abu Zafer Siddiky @ Akhter was the informant of Akkelpur P. S. case No.2(6) 1991 under section 457/380 of the Penal Code in respect of his stolen motor cycle being registration No. Naogaon A-661 Chassis No, AHBH-100S-14155 Engine No Ha-041?-5103914 and after return of the Motor cycle, Akkelpur police station case No. 2(6) 1991 was ended in FRT No.7 dated 01.09.1991:
